evidence.quote:
A rollback
we have not rehearsed is a rollback we do not actually have.

observations.why: Identity-level bedrock: an unrehearsed rollback is defined as no rollback at all — constitutive rule stated as creed, not merely a settled choice.
Operational cadence set as a settled, load-bearing directive the org is expected to act on — ratification language, not an argued position.
Assignment of ownership ratifies the decision — a performed declarative that settles accountability, not an argued claim.

mints.name: UnrehearsedCapabilityIsNoCapability
mints.title: a capability we have not rehearsed is a capability we do not actually have
mints.frame: Does the expression define a capability's existence by whether it has been exercised, treating rehearsal as constitutive of possession?
